purpose: Provide Henry one professional operating view of every GitHub department while preserving direct Mac Henry inspection authority and strict department isolation.
department_isolation: Department assistants report only to Henry and do not receive direct control channels to other department assistants. Cross-department work is routed and logged by Henry.

visual_behavior.department_cards: professional cards with restrained department-specific under-glow
visual_behavior.attention: slow pulse or halo only for material items requiring attention
visual_behavior.critical: clear severity treatment without rapid flashing
visual_behavior.ask_henry: visible site-support entry, distinct from private manager dashboard

privacy_boundary: Dashboard does not expose Mac Henry private Brain, cross-business private strategy, private enterprise financial context, hidden reasoning, credentials, keys, tokens or seed phrases into the GitHub branch.
